'''Craeen''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Corellian sector/Legends|Corellian sector]] colonized by [[Corellian/Legends|Corellians]].

==History==
Generally hospitable to [[Human/Legends|human]]s, Craeen was colonized by Corellians primarily for its wealth of mineral resources. Technology and manufacturing firms founded operations on the planet, especially when its administration offered extensive tax breaks and other incentives. Craeen's environment suffered from lax regulations on industry and development, though an influx of scientists, engineers, and other experts turned it into a haven for scientific discovery and engineering innovation.<ref name="SOF" />
